description: Presidential Secretariat - Enlarge the Period of time of Special Presidential Commission of Inquiry up to 28th April 2022
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Special Presidential Commissions of Inquiry Act to extend the deadline for a commission's final report. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it deals with the implementation and modification of statutory timelines under existing legislation, specifically addressing procedural aspects of a presidential commission of inquiry established by law.
